noClientAccess.title: No client access
noClientAccess.description: You currently have no client assigned. Once a client is assigned to you, your metrics will appear here.

dashboard.loadError: An error occurred while fetching the data.

descriptions.slack: Your direct line to the We.Publish team. This is where we discuss everything about your project.
descriptions.weShare: The network-wide exchange across all We.Publish media. Tips, questions and shared learning.
descriptions.editor: The editorial system for your website. Create and edit your articles and content here.
descriptions.jira: Tasks, tickets and requests around your project – transparently tracked.
descriptions.website: Your published website, just as your readers see it.
descriptions.docs: Guides and help for We.Publish. Look up how everything works.

workLogAlert.haltedTitle: {count} ticket is stopped | {count} tickets are stopped
workLogAlert.haltedDescription: The affected tickets must not be worked on until the stop is lifted.
workLogAlert.openWarningsDescription: For some tickets the Jira estimate is used up or exceeded.
workLogAlert.resolvedDescription: The related Jira tickets are marked as Done or Cancelled — no action needed.

over_budget.headline: Budget exceeded
over_budget.body: {used} of the budget used. Please consult the project lead.

no_budget.headline: No budget recorded
no_budget.body: {hours} already logged, but no top-up recorded. These hours will be billed separately unless a budget is added.

close_to_limit.headline: Budget almost used up
close_to_limit.body: {used} of the budget used, {time} of the time elapsed. Plan the remaining hours carefully.

behind_schedule.headline: Budget is being used up faster than time
behind_schedule.body: {used} of the budget used, but only {time} of the time elapsed ({delta} faster than planned).

ahead_of_schedule.headline: More budget left than expected
ahead_of_schedule.body: Only {used} of the budget used, {time} of the time elapsed ({delta} under plan). Plenty of headroom.

refreshTooltip.noCache: Reload data from Jira and Clockodo
refreshTooltip.live: Clear cache and reload — the data is already live (cache {expires}). Only click if something has changed in Jira or Clockodo since.
refreshTooltip.cached: Clear cache and fetch fresh data from Jira & Clockodo. (Cache created {age} ago, {expires}.)

cache.infoIntro: Jira and Clockodo rate-limit requests ("429 Too Many Requests"). To keep the dashboard fast and stable for everyone, the aggregated hours per project and period are cached on the server for one hour.
cache.infoLiveText: just fetched directly from Jira & Clockodo.
cache.infoCacheText: stored copy, may be up to an hour old.
cache.infoOutro: Click the refresh icon to clear the cache for the currently selected period and re-query Jira & Clockodo. Other projects or periods are unaffected.
cache.refreshSuccessWithMeta: Freshly fetched from Jira & Clockodo — cache {expires}.
cache.refreshSuccessWithoutMeta: Jira and Clockodo data has been reloaded.

contractWarning.title: Contract not signed
contractWarning.description: No signed contract is on file for this client. Please upload the signed contract.
